title: Zeng Niu's Name Spreads
summary: As the Celestial dies, Wang Lin's Life and Death domain reaches its second level and brings him half a step from mid Soul Formation, and Zhou Yi's sword shadow drives Ling Tianhou back. Wang Lin is left holding two Rain Celestial Swords, and cultivators of the Hun Yuan Sect, the Sky Devil Sect and the Heaven and Earth Sect demand them. He kills Lu Tianrui with his domain, and Sun Tai comes out of hiding and slaughters the rest in exchange for a thousand years of freedom. Wang Lin and Chi Hu return to Planet Suzaku, where news of Hongdie's severed arm makes the name Zeng Niu famous. At the Suzaku Mountain altar, Feng Yushan reports that the real Zeng Niu of Tianhun Country is only a Foundation Establishment cultivator, and a kill order is issued, then withdrawn by Mount Suzaku.
events: Wang Lin's Life and Death domain advances during the Celestial's death
Zhou Yi's sword shadow holds off Ling Tianhou
Hun Yuan, Sky Devil and Heaven and Earth Sect cultivators demand the two swords
Wang Lin kills Lu Tianrui in a battle of domains
Sun Tai kills the rest in exchange for a thousand years of freedom
Wang Lin and Chi Hu return to Planet Suzaku and part as friends
The Suzaku Country orders Zeng Niu killed, then Mount Suzaku cancels the order
cultivation: Wang Lin's Life and Death domain reaches mid Soul Formation level (second level) while his cultivation stays early Soul Formation, half a step from mid. Zhuang Yi and Nie Ming are early Soul Formation; Lu Tianrui and Feng Yushan are mid Soul Formation.
